div.l: And yet he had . a thombe of golde parde .
A white cote . ⁊and a blewe hood . wered he .
A bagge pipe . well couthe he blowe ⁊and sowne .
And ther with all . he brought vs oute of towne .
A gentill Manciple . was there of a temple .
Of whiche achatorurs . myght take exemple .
For to ben wise . in byeng of vitaile .
For whether that he paied . or toke bi tayle .
Algate he waited so in his achat .
That he was aye biforn . in good a stat .
Now is not that of god . a full fayre grace .
That suche a lewde mannes wit . schall pace .
The wisdam . of an heep of lerned men .
Of maistris had he . mo than thries ten .
That were of lawe . experte ⁊and curious .
Of whiche ther / were . a doseyn in that hous .
Worthi to ben stiwardis . of rent ⁊and londe .
Of eny lorde . that is in Englonde .
To make hym leue . bi his ꝓpropre good .
In honorur detteles . but if that he were wood .
Or lyue as scarsly . as hym list desire .
And able for to helpen . all a schire .
In eny caas . that myght falle or happe .
An yet this manciple . set he alther cappe .
The Reue was . a sklendir colrik man .
His berde was schaue . as nygh as eủer he can .
His her was bi his eres . full rounde schorn.
His toppe was dokked . like a preest biforn .
Full longe were his leggis . ⁊and full lene .
Like a staf . ther was no calf sene .
Well couthe he kepe a gerner or a bynne .
Ther was noon auditorur . couthe on hym wynne .
Well wist he . be the draught . ⁊and bi the reyne .
The yeldyng of his seed . ⁊and of his greyne
His lordis scheep . his neet . ⁊and his dairye .
His swyn . his hors . his store . ⁊and his pultrye .
Was hooly in this Reuys gouernyng .
And bi his couenaūnt . yaf he his rekenyng .
Syn that his lorde . was twenti yere of age .
Ther couthe no man . brynge hym in arrerage .
Ther nas baile . heerde . nor other hyne /
That he ne knewe . his sleight ⁊and his couyne .
Thei were a drad of hym . as of the deth .
His wonyng was full fayre . vp on an heth .
With grene trees . schadwed was his place .
He couthe bettir . than his lorde purchace .
Full riche he was . astorid pryuely . /
